contentPattern.structure: circular image + name + role + social links

suitableFor: people directories where each card is a circular avatar + name + role/tagline + social links
centered, borderless card grids of individuals
notSuitableFor: article / adventure listing grids with landscape image + description (use cards-article)
promotional teasers with a CTA and image-at-bottom (use cards-promo)

breakdown.structure: low overlap (image + title shared; team adds role + social links, drops description) -> +0.03
low overlap; promo has description + CTA, team has role + social links -> +0.02

similarityEvaluation.reason: Both existing cards variants score well below the 80% threshold. The About Us grids are a people/team pattern - circular avatar + name + role tagline + a strip of 3 social icon links, with no description text and no body CTA - which is structurally distinct from cards-article (landscape image + title + description) and cards-promo (title + description + CTA + image-at-bottom). A dedicated 'cards-profile' variant is warranted.
